comment: The description may imply that the LHR is the authoritative source of all clinical data. In many implementations, source clinical systems remain authoritative and the LHR maintains copies, summaries, references, or indexed access.

citation.raw: §Lifelong Health Record, 1 p.155-156 l.Purpose and scope

anchor.note: p.155-156 read as the printed page, no line resolved; in the cited section

public.text: The description may imply that the LHR is the authoritative source of all clinical data. In many implementations, source clinical systems remain authoritative and the LHR maintains copies, summaries, references, or indexed access.
public.suggestedRevision: Distinguish source clinical records, contributed copies, derived summaries, document indexes, and federated references. Require provenance and source authority to be retained for every item.
